text:
alex: uploaded a perfetto trace from an intermittent e2e run (client->gateway->runtime) — seeing 120-600ms tail spikes at low QPS (1-4 rps). trace: https://perfetto.dev/trace/f7a2c1e4 (uploaded)

maria: quick glance: spikes correlate with 'kernel_select' churn inside runtime span and a burst of KV cache activity. batching heuristic seems to flip batch size mid-flight.

jyoti: ran an nsys capture on a focused repro. hot path sequence: conv_attn_opt -> matmul_small_fallback -> kv_cache_flush. fallback matmul latency is ~4x normal in those windows.

chris: can we get the perfetto flame around 00:04:12? suspect host->device memcpy overlap and PCIe queuing are worsening the fallback cost.

alex: flame excerpt (annotated):
```
00:04:08 runtime.handle_request
  runtime.choose_kernel(policy=adaptive)  <-- 10ms
  runtime.batch_controller(batch=28->7)   <-- 520ms spike
    kernel: conv_attn_opt (9ms)
    kernel: matmul_fallback_small (410ms)
  runtime.kv_cache.flush (many pages)   <-- 60ms
```

maria: heuristic detail: we clamp batch when prefix_len > 1000, but here the estimator toggles because inflight concurrency drops quickly. current estimator uses instantaneous inflight; that's noisy.

jyoti: perf counters from nsys show shared L2 hit rate falling from ~76% -> ~20% during spike intervals. fallback kernel access pattern is very scattery, losing locality.

perf-bot: trace ingested: perfetto/1768029001 by alex (size 18MB). tags: perf-e2e,kernel-selection,kv-cache,perfetto

chris: repro plan: A/B test kernel_selection_threshold 0.55 vs 0.9 under synthetic load 1-4 rps with randomized prefix lengths to trigger estimator oscillation. i'll push a harness.

alex: load harness posted: https://git.internal/runs/perf-214 (includes NVTX annotations around batch boundary and client/gateway spans)

maria: short-term mitigation: pin model to the stable kernel set (disable fallback) for the affected fleet until we ship heuristic smoothing. note: could raise 95p on older GPUs (T4). ops, please monitor.

jyoti: next steps for captures:
- nsys with --trace=nvtx,cuda_runtime,cudnn for 30s during repro
- perfetto with full kernel names + cpu stacks
- micro-benchmark to exercise kv_cache.flush pattern (contiguous vs many small writes)

alex: i'll take the nsys + perfetto captures. chris will run the A/B. maria will prototype an EWMA smoothing of inflight estimator (1s window).

chris: also adding a CI regression job that replays this randomized pattern and asserts kernel-selection stability and L2 hit rate baseline :thumbsup:

maria: long-term fixes: smoother estimator, prefetch KV pages before switching batch modes, and pin small-batch optimized kernels in memory to avoid on-the-fly fallback.

jyoti: if we confirm L2 collapse, prefetching KV pages and switching to contiguous writes may prevent fallback. will add perf counters to kernel_select path to expose this metric.

alex: filed RW-8230 with links to trace, nsys outputs, load harness, and mitigation plan. tagging @oncall and ops for visibility.

ops: acknowledged. we'll watch staging T4 95p if you enable no-fallback.

alex: reconvene after captures (ETA ~3h). thanks all :rocket:
